pr_body:
This test could fail if run from a secondary tenant. It can be fixed by enabling a cluster setting.

fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/113820
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/113853

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/113826)

> Rebasing this PR will add this line: [master/pkg/ccl/testutilsccl/alter_primary_key.go#L65](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/master/pkg/ccl/testutilsccl/alter_primary_key.go?rgh-link-date=2023-11-07T12%3A13%3A32Z#L65)
As it was skipped as part of this issue: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/113853
After rebasing the test looks like it will work with a shared process virtual cluster, as this was the cause of this failure.
So might be good just to remove the lines above that will disable it.

Thanks for the heads up - I've removed those lines that disabled the test for tenants.

bors r+
